Direct interface-member WPROTO003 is now checked with and without a declared-root registration.

Ten literal-input cases pin unknown-field loss on root and nested consumer read/rewrite across all five skippable wire forms, while preserving known values through direct, facade and pinned oracle operations. The obsolete FastVector3Int cached-hash example was replaced with an ordinary ascending-tag example.
